summary: Augment enum object with namespace exports.

source.pattern: enum E { A=1 } namespace E { export const extra=2 }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: coexist
tests.input: enum E { A=1 }; namespace E { export const extra=2 }; console.log(E.A,E[1],E.extra);

tests.name: identity
tests.input: enum E { A=1 }; const r=E; namespace E { export const x=1 }; console.log(r===E);
